purpose: Reviewable historical fixture observations, not accepted native runtime coverage or evidence of the later process execution gate.

historical/claude-visible-events.jsonl.selection: Visible assistant text/tool calls, user tool results, final result; omit reasoning, usage, account rate limits, system initialization and stderr.

historical/claude-verified-visible-event.selection: Visible assistant text/tool calls, user tool results, final result; omit reasoning, usage, account rate limits, system initialization and stderr.

historical/claude-boundary-visible-event.selection: Visible assistant text/tool calls, user tool results, final result; omit reasoning, usage, account rate limits, system initialization and stderr.

preserved: Tool input/result fields and identity/correlation metadata are copied as recorded; text field contents are not rewritten. Original local paths identify controlled fixtures, not retrievable host directories.
omitted: Hidden reasoning blocks, usage/cost/account rate-limit telemetry, unrelated CLI initialization and stderr, authentication/configuration files, full fixture virtualenvs. No original authentication material was selected.
run_states: Recorded coordinator measurements and outcomes; read alongside visible native tool events, not as independent proof of their own narrative.
source_versions: Native reads in event streams show the actual instruction versions; source-10579a9.json is the implemented pre-review source. Old observations do not establish acceptance for the revised process gate.

current_process_gate_export.selection: Same visible-message field allowlist as historical Claude exports; fixture/contract and measured no-execution state are published separately.
current_process_gate_export.claim_limit: Only a direct denied-path native handoff. The separate actual PEP 517 experiment is not a native agent run.
